concept: Reading observational labor research: group comparisons, causal assumptions and percentage points
finding: Testing/evaluation and output-checking lessons do not specifically teach observational labor estimates or percentage-point comparisons. Do not force an adjacent AI benchmark lesson to carry this statistical concept.
trigger: Admission of a governed statistical evidence-reading lesson or an exact research reading activity
interimTeaching: Article defines task exposure, separates group comparison from individual diagnosis, demonstrates point/percent arithmetic, and names omissions and confounding.
